result.rationale: Accurate and grounded: the controller defines saveChanges() calling this.get('embedding').update({}), the adapter routes to PUT /admin/customize/embedding, but embedding.hbs contains no button bound to saveChanges, and Admin::EmbeddingController#update merely renders the serializer over an OpenStruct with no persistence logic. The whole path is dead/no-op wiring. This is a legitimate, specific review concern (misleading dead endpoint that silently does nothing if wired up), but not incorrect behavior introduced by the diff since nothing invokes it — hence important_non_bug rather than bug.
